title: Construct a table-free reversible draw for the paired denominator-13 sampler
body:
## Summary

Scoped construction with an exact finite certificate. One draw of the fixed (1/13, 1/13) paired sampler replaces its 702-byte transition table with a reversible arithmetic circuit. It preserves the outcome and first stopping depth on each ordered coin path.

```text
Before: phase/node and coin -> stored transition lookup
After:  phase/node and coin -> modular digits -> reversible packet update
```

The circuit uses 3,060 gates (232 X, 2,238 CNOT and 590 Toffoli) and 484 clean work bits. The bill includes packet copying, swapping and uncomputation. The stored transition payload is replaced by arithmetic. Circuit description and physical execution have their own costs.

## Evidence

The verifier compares the emitted gates with an integer-floor specification for all 624 reachable packet and coin pairs. It checks the full forward and inverse maps, coin preservation, clean workspace, and two fault controls. Both registered modes passed in 0.11 seconds each on CPython 3.12.15. Package metadata, committed bytes, file modes, source ancestry and the generated export receipt passed. Both exact commands also passed from a read-only Git-free export.

Reproduce from the repository root with CPython 3.12 and its standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step --check-source-history --check-modes
python3.12 -E -s -B -W error -X dev research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step/verify.py
python3.12 -E -s -B -O -W error -X dev research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step/verify.py
```

The direct commands print `PASS_PAIRED_DDG_ARITHMETIC_STEP` and the gate and wire counts. The proof and source pins are under `research/paired-ddg-arithmetic-step/`.

## Limitations

The circuit prices one draw for one fixed pair. Stopping time remains unbounded. Physical tape movement, stopping storage, conditional freshness and the actual caller bill remain open. Native and selected scientific replays, Lean and Docker were unrun. The selected κ is unaffected.

## Open next questions

- Install the circuit in #6102's cursor and counter protocol and charge every movement and cleanup operation for a terminating path.
- Derive all four weight residues from a shared phase for runtime residue parameters and price their preparation and arithmetic.

## Related open work

- [#7187](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7187) shares resident tables across 144 pairs using output symmetries. This contribution removes the transition data for one pair and preserves that pair's ordered coin-to-output function. The two resource counts cover different scopes.
